sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Aggressive is an uncensored variant of the Qwen3.5-9B large language model, fine-tuned by Hugging Face user HauhauCS to achieve zero refusals on prompts while retaining the original model's full capabilities, multilingual support for languages including English and Chinese, and lossless performance without alterations to training datasets.
